name: thread-mind
description: Git-friendly memory for AI coding sessions: a tree of thread summaries, loaded when a session starts and kept up to date as it goes

reminders.title: Summary reminders
reminders.description: When the conversation grows while the thread's summary isn't saved: nudge (Claude saves it), warn (only you are told) or off

reminder_tokens.title: Tokens between reminders
reminder_tokens.description: How much the conversation grows, in tokens, before each reminder

context_threshold.title: Last reminder before compaction (% of context)
context_threshold.description: When the context window is this full, Claude is reminded to save the summary before the conversation gets compacted

compact_summary.title: Save the summary after a compaction
compact_summary.description: When the conversation is compacted before its work was saved, Claude saves the summary first thing afterwards

instant_commands.title: Instant tm:tree and tm:stats
instant_commands.description: Show the thread tree and statistics directly, without sending the request to Claude (no tokens used)

context_window.title: Context window size (tokens)
context_window.description: 0 to detect it. The ThreadMind status line reports the exact size
